m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Sss! How dare you! You can't do this! The King of Thieves gave us free reign... by what right can you take it away?!
By the right of the common good and the rule of law, and with the full authority I have as your Sultana. Begone, Snake, and never return!
Achmad Peece, Ali Baboon, I trust that I still have your commitment to my terms?
Yes, your Majesty. You have Ali Baboon's undying loyalty, and you, Djinni, have my undying admiration.
Um... Master, are we done here?
Indeed. Wizard, Ozzy, let us rejoin the others, back in my true home, Kasra Palace.
Haha! Well done, everyone! If I could only have a portrait painted to capture the look on Loother Ray's face... it was a priceless moment.
I will send a messenger to each of the gangs to meet at the Four Points. Istar and I will go ahead and be there to meet them as they arrive.
Swan, you know what to do. Your part in this is critical. I wish you both the best of luck.
Wizard, Ozzy I hope you will join us at the Four Points. I suspect there is a significant chance our talks will turn ugly. Let's go.
